heroSubtitle: From general AI literacy to Microsoft-certified courses and hands-on provider training. Webinars, workshops, and coaching designed for healthcare teams — delivered by a trainer participants consistently rate as the best they've had.

programs.title: Training
programs.subtitle: Three tracks that meet your teams where they are.

items.title: General AI Training
items.description: AI fundamentals, responsible use, prompt engineering, and workflow applications — for leadership, clinical, and administrative teams. No technical background required.

items.title: Microsoft-Certified AI Training
items.description: Official Microsoft courses (AB-730, AB-900, Copilot Builders) delivered by a Microsoft Certified Trainer with deep healthcare experience.

items.title: Ambient AI Training
items.description: Hands-on training for ambient clinical documentation — Nuance DAX and Sunoh.ai by eClinicalWorks — from onboarding through adoption coaching.

formats.title: Training
formats.subtitle: Flexible delivery designed to meet your team where they are.

items.title: Webinars
items.description: Live, interactive sessions that introduce AI concepts and use cases to large groups. Ideal for building awareness across your organization.

items.title: Virtual Workshops
items.description: Hands-on, small-group sessions delivered remotely. Participants work through real scenarios and leave with skills they can apply immediately.

items.title: In-Person Workshops
items.description: On-site training tailored to your team's workflows and tools. The most immersive format for teams ready to put AI into practice.

items.title: Coaching
items.description: Ongoing one-on-one or small-group coaching that reinforces learning and supports adoption over time.

ctaSubtitle: Let's talk about which training track fits your organization.
